blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water Company, Inc. (Manila Water) and Manila Water Philippine Ventures Cebu (MWPVC) have once again brought Philippine water utilities to the international energy stage, earning podium finishes at the ASEAN Energy Awards (AEA) 2026. Manila Water’s 2.5 MWp Solar Project, recognized as the largest consolidated solar installation in the Philippine water sector, was named 2nd Runner-up in the On-Grid Self-Consumption Category under the ASEAN Renewable Energy Project Awards. Meanwhile, MWPV-Cebu secured 1st Runner-up in the Energy Management in Buildings and Industries – Small & Medium Industries Category under the ASEAN Energy Efficiency and Conservation Best Practices Awards.
